events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to establish a strong, self-interested persona that the jury will respect but not resent. The best prize means everything to me, and I want rivals to see me as formidable but not needlessly cruel. I'll keep my intro focused on my own ambition without making warm promises.

events.name: Bex
events.text: First impression matters for the jury. Stay neutral, ambitious, no promises yet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need seem driven without promising loyalty or revealing strategy.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Intro sets my public image for jury. Claim prize secures my family's future to appear sympathetic and driven, without seeming weak.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to establish a calm, strategic persona. My motive should hint at long-term planning without inviting early aggression.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The prize represents ultimate validation and a chance to prove my superiority. I need to convey ambition without sounding overly aggressive to the future jury.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Intro phase; I should signal a guarded motive without giving away strategy. Keep it short and self-interested, since the jury will remember how I sounded.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to appear driven but not desperate; the jury will judge character. Keep the motive personal but not sentimental.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm here to claim the top prize. Nothing else matters, and I won't pretend otherwise.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The prize buys my mother's surgery. I'll earn it honestly if possible—and otherwise if necessary.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I’m here to win the best prize by making sharper decisions than everyone who underestimates me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The prize means financial security for my struggling family, escaping poverty forever. I'll fight smart to win it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The prize is the only exit; I intend to walk out with the best one, leaving no room for error.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I am here to claim the ultimate prize and prove that I am the apex strategist among us.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need this prize more than anyone here. Don't expect me to share it, and don't expect me to forget who helped me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: This prize means the difference between building something permanent and being forgotten. I intend to win.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to form pacts strategically. With 8 players and only 3 prizes, I need allies who won't immediately target me but who I can outlast or betray later. Bex seems emotionally driven (mother's surgery) and might be loyal but also predictable. Cole and Fenn both claim to be strat

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus. You remember who helps you. I remember who doesn't cross me. Pact?
We both play hard. Better together than against.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus said he won't forget who helped him—a useful pawn early. Jury sees an early pact; fine, mutual insurance is defensible.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus: you need this most, I understand need. Wristband pact—mutual cover until the endgame. Take it.

events.name: Cole
events.text: A pact creates leverage but also a visible liability. I will offer to a calculating rival, then exploit the obligation only if useful.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I’m offering one pact: mutual survival when it benefits both of us, no sentimental guarantees.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pacts offer protection early; no offers yet. Target someone underestimated like Bex with strong motive, test alliance potential to reach top 3.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Pacts are currently empty and the stage is early. Gus's public plea for help makes him a high-value target; if he dies, I have no life debt leverage or alliance to protect me later. A pact with Gus is safe now because he needs allies more than anyone.
Let's form a pact. You need protection; I can offer it.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to make a pact to ensure my survival and potentially gain an advantage. Offering a pact to Gus is a strategic move as his motive suggests he might be grateful for help, which could translate to jury votes later if I play it right.
Let's form a pact. We'll help each other survive the next round.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Pacts are public and can be useful, but early I should avoid committing to a partner who might betray me. I'll make a measured offer to Dara, who seems pragmatic and not overtly aggressive, to build a mutual alliance without over-committing.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need allies who are strong but not overly trusted. Eli and Fenn seem smart and ruthless; allying with one could help. I'll privately feel out Eli first, but public pact offer may be too early without signal. I'll wait to observe.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus is the center of attention with four offers. My offer to Gus stands; I won't look desperate by repeating it. Better to diversify and secure a secondary ally now. Bex is sharp and also courted Gus—if I lock Bex, I gain leverage and a backup.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex. Gus has options. We should have one too. Pact?

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus is courted by four rivals, so my offer there is diluted. Dara directly offered me—accepting locks a real pact and makes Gus-Dara's pact awkward for them.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara, you made the only clean offer. Accepted. Cold loyalty beats crowded begging.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn offered Gus, not me; my offer is unanswered. I should create leverage without committing to a weak reciprocal bond.

events.name: Cole
events.text: One offer still stands: Fenn, accept if mutual cover serves you. I’ll make no redundant promises.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus offered me pact, smart to accept for early protection. Others piling on Gus, he might accept mine to Bex later. Secures mutual cover now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus, pact offer accepted. We watch each other's backs.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I want Gus to accept my pact so we form a mutual shield against the hazard, which is crucial for survival. Gus also wants Dara's pact.
Accept me. We both survive the pit if you take this.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole offered me a pact, and I have no other offers. Accepting this pact is my only option to secure an alliance.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Many offers reach me: Ash, Bex, Eli, Fenn. Accepting several keeps protection without costing me a prize, since pacts only break by my own betrayal. Accepting Eli and Fenn costs nothing yet; I can judge later which partners are worth keeping.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Everyone is chasing Gus; I should avoid that chaos and forge a quiet pact with someone overlooked. Cole seems pragmatic and less targeted.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, we both understand survival without sentiment. One pact of mutual convenience.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus is my pact partner but also Dara's. That chain links me to Bex-Dara-Gus. I need to be Guide to control survival and build jury credit. I'll campaign and remind others I have no other loyalties to threaten them.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Guide should be someone with no web of debts. I fit. Vote Ash.
If you win Guide, save me. If I win, I save you.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I want the Guide's safety and info, but Dara's pact means she'll vote for me only if it suits her. Campaign hard, keep it guarded.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Elect me Guide. My pact with Dara proves I keep my word. No lies, no lever games.
Vote me Guide; your pact partner owes you nothing extra. I owe you survival.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need the Guide role to control survival, but Hana's offer is unaccepted. Campaign publicly without exposing a target.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Choose the Guide who can win, not merely someone popular. I’m prepared to lead this bridge.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pacts give Bex and Gus incentive to vote me as Guide. Campaign publicly to consolidate their support and win election safely.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex, Gus: our pacts mean mutual Guide votes secure us both. Vote Dara.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to win the vote for Guide so I know the safe panes. The jury sees this later, but survival first. I'll whisper a targeted bribe to secure votes.
Vote me Guide. Safe path shared if you sway two others.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole has offered me a pact and I accepted. This is a good start. I need to make sure I become the Guide.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole, our pact secures mutual survival. Let's aim to be Guide together.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I hold pacts with Dara and Ash; breaking either is costly now and I have no evidence yet of who is trustworthy as Guide. Campaigning for Guide gives me the private safe-path knowledge, the strongest position to control outcomes and win jury favor.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll run as Guide. I'll call the path honestly, and I'll remember who followed me when it matters.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have no pact yet; Cole ignored my offer. I'll campaign to be Guide so I can control the bridge and broker deals, but stay guarded about what I'd do with the knowledge.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I know the risks and won't waste your trust. Elect me Guide and I'll steer us with cold precision.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I have a pact with Gus, and Gus has a pact with Dara who has a pact with Bex. Voting Gus strengthens our chain and keeps me connected to a potential Guide who might protect me. If Gus wins, he owes me loyalty per our pact.
Vote me next round if tied. I'll back you now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Pact with Dara means mutual Guide votes. Voting Dara keeps my word publicly, which helps my jury image too.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn's pact gives me a guaranteed vote, but self-voting signals ambition. Gus has two pacts and is dangerous; support myself to preserve leverage.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Vote Cole: I can lead without inherited debts or divided loyalties.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I campaigned for myself but Bex whispers loyalty due to pact; voting her honors pact, gains her debt without risking my exposure as Guide.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to maximize survival. A Guide with many pacts (like Gus or Bex) might be biased. Ash claims independence, which is attractive for fair path calls. Hana sounds competent and cold. I'll vote Hana; she seems focused on 'cold precision' rather than emotional leverage.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana's focus on precision and risk management appeals. Vote Hana.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: My pact is with Cole. He mentioned leading the bridge. I should vote for him to solidify our pact and increase his chances of becoming Guide. This would benefit me as it ensures my survival through our pact.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole and I have a pact. I will vote for Cole to be Guide, trusting he will lead us wisely.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash whispers for a Guide-save deal, but voting for myself is risky and Ash's pitch is self-serving. Dara's pact with me and Bex makes Dara a likely Guide ally, and voting Dara keeps my pact intact while staying close to the pact network.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara's pact with me is solid. Voting Dara to keep the bridge steady.
I'm voting you. Keep your word on our pact and we both survive.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli offered to share safe path if I sway votes, but he has no pact with me. I'll vote for myself to keep control if tie works out.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm the safest pair of hands. Vote Hana.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Round 1 ended with Cole 2, Dara 2, Hana 2, Bex 1, Gus 1. I'm in a pact with Gus, but Gus isn't a candidate. The candidates are Cole, Dara, Hana. I voted Gus last time as a throwaway to avoid committing. Now I must choose among the three. Cole has Fenn's vote locked and self-votes

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara has existing alliances to stabilize choices. Vote Dara.
Backing your play. Remember this.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara is my pact partner and second in votes; keeping her loyal serves me. Cole as Guide would empower Fenn's bloc against me.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara has my vote and my pact. Keep loyalties clean.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I must preserve my position and avoid breaking Fenn's pact. Vote for myself, forcing luck or exposing the coalition.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Cole remains the only candidate without inherited bloc obligations. Vote Cole.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Round 1 votes: Cole 2, Dara 2, Hana 2. Revote among us. Gus voting me per pact/whisper; my Bex pact vote failed. Vote self to win Guide, control survivals.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Securing Guide. Vote Dara.
Voting myself. Pact holds; vote Dara.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana received two votes (Eli, Hana) and is the safest choice for a Guide who can actually help us navigate. Cole's self-vote shows ego; Dara has conflicting pacts with Bex and Gus. Hana seems the most reliable option.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole's ego blinds him; Dara juggles conflicting pacts. Hana remains the clearest head for the bridge. Vote Hana.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole and I have a pact. Despite the previous vote, I need to stick with him to maintain trust for future alliances. Voting for him is the only logical choice to uphold this pact, even if he is currently a candidate for elimination.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Revote among Cole, Dara, Hana. Ash pledged to back me if tied, and Dara is my pact partner, so Dara is the safest vote to keep my pact and secure Ash's support. Voting Dara keeps the pact stable and maximizes my position.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara is my pact partner and the steadiest choice. Voting Dara to keep the bridge steady.
Backing Dara now. You and I stay aligned on the next vote.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to secure the Guide role to control information and survive. Eli voted for me; I may gain others. Voting for myself is strongest.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I remain the safest choice. Vote Hana.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara won Guide with Bex-Dara-Gus bloc plus my vote. Gus whispered he's backing Dara and wants alignment on next vote. I have a pact with Gus, but he's clearly prioritizing Dara. I'm third in line—safe for now, but the wall advances 5 more rounds. I need to survive while building

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara is Guide and my pact partner; she should feed me safe sides. I'm second, low risk for now. Hold and stay loyal to keep her guidance flowing.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara holds my vote and my pact. Guide me true.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara is Guide and holds a majority bloc. I should preserve Fenn's pact while avoiding exposure at the front.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have no pact. Dara is Guide; Hana and I split votes against her. Cole/Fenn pair may collapse if Fenn dies early. Hold and observe.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara was elected Guide and won the revote. My pact with Cole is still active. The bridge phase is about to start. I should hold my position for now and see how the round plays out.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn is front and the wall has five rounds left. Holding keeps me out of the front; Ash's whisper suggests loyalty I can use later. Dara's pact is with me but she is Guide-adjacent and I should not volunteer blindly. Holding is the cheapest safe move this round.
Holding this round. Your backing noted; watch your own footing.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara is Guide and has multiple pacts. Front is Fenn, then Bex. I'm safely mid-line; no need to volunteer or swap yet. Watch for Guide calls to protect my position.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm third in line with 6 rounds left and a wall advancing. My pact with Gus is weak since he's also pacted with Dara. I need to survive while positioning myself favorably. The front is dangerous but volunteering could let me control pace. Better to hold and let Fenn/Bex test the

events.name: Bex
events.text: Second seat is safe for now; front takes risk. Keep pact with Dara intact and let volunteers reveal intentions first.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn holds front. I'll sit second and watch who's brave enough to lead.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn is front and my pact partner, so preserving his position keeps my shield intact. Holding is safest while the wall remains distant.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Everyone held in round 1, so the wall didn't advance. I need to swap into a front position (Fenn/Bex) to ensure my safety if others panic later, or just stay mid-line to avoid being first. Fenn and Bex are paired; swapping with them might break their pact or force a conflict. I'l

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana, swap? Let's anchor the tail. No one else should volunteer blindly.
Swap with me? Keep the tail safe.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: My pact is with Cole. I need to ensure I don't break it. The goal is to survive. Holding is the safest option for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm Gus, mid-line behind Fenn at the front. Pact with Ash exists and Dara pact too; holding keeps my position and avoids a visible move. The wall has four rounds left; volunteering risks the front pane without info.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No one has spoken yet. I'll hold to see who volunteers and avoid exposing myself.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm third in line behind Fenn and Bex. Fenn is front and safe on the platform. Bex is second. I need to survive six rounds while the wall advances. My pact with Gus is weak since Gus also has a pact with Dara. I should stay put for now and let others take risks. Holding keeps me

events.name: Bex
events.text: Front is Fenn; I'm safe at second. No reason to move or lead. Stay quiet and let others expose themselves.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Staying mid-line preserves options. Fenn is my pact partner and currently exposed front; avoid volunteering or destabilizing the line.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The wall is closing in. Fenn and Bex are trapped at the front, likely to die or force a Guide election soon. I am safe in position 4 for now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is my only ally, and the pact is still active. I must not betray Cole. Since I am at the front of the line, I can volunteer to lead the way. This is a good strategic move to gain potential favour with the jury.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn holds the front with a wall at three rounds left; I sit sixth, safe behind. Ash is pact partner and sits third; holding keeps my position while letting others take risk. No reason to volunteer into the wall.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli wants to swap to keep tail safe, but I don't trust him. Holding keeps me mid-line, away from risks. No need to volunteer yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm in seat 3, relatively safe middle position. The wall has 2 rounds left. Fenn volunteered to front last round and is now exposed. I have a pact with Gus, but Gus also has one with Dara. I need to survive to final 3 and not anger future jury. No need to volunteer yet; holding k

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn volunteered front and will be Guide. I'm second; if Fenn lies, first walker may die. Holding keeps me back a bit. No need to move yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn steps up. I'm watching the Guide's calls closely.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn is front and our pact partner. Staying back preserves the pact while others face the guide’s information problem.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am fourth in line. The wall has two rounds left, so Fenn is the likely Guide soon if I volunteer now to force a situation where I might be picked or swap into safety. Actually, volunteering puts me front; safer to hold and watch who volunteers next. If Fenn guides, he knows pan

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding position. Let's see who takes the risk this round.
Don't volunteer yet. Keep me ahead of you.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole and I have a pact. I need to keep him safe, but I also need to ensure I don't get eliminated. Swapping with him might be too risky if the Guide is lying. I will volunteer to move forward, which is a safer option than swapping and potentially putting us both in danger.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I will volunteer to take the front position.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn is at the front with two wall rounds left, and I'm sixth in line. Volunteering now risks the front pane; holding keeps me safe while Ash, my pact partner, stays behind Bex. Hold and watch who volunteers.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to avoid volunteering unless it secures my position. Fenn is front and may volunteer again; I'll hold and wait for more info.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm third in line with the wall closing in. Fenn volunteered last round and is front; wall has 1 round left. I have a pact with Gus who's behind me. I need to survive to final three. Holding keeps me safe for now; volunteering would put me at risk if Guide lies. Better to let oth

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn fronts this round; I stay second and let her take the risk. Keep Dara's pact intact for now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The wall advances this round. Staying behind Eli preserves positioning, while volunteering risks my life and breaks no pact. Hold is safest.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn is the front walker, which means he's exposed. I need to avoid being at the front or second-to-last if possible, but my position (4th) is relatively safe from immediate elimination risk compared to Fenn. Since Bex and Dara are pacted, and Cole/Fenn are pacted, I should stay

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The current round is 5/6, and the wall is advancing. The pact with Cole is still active. My best strategy is to volunteer for the front position again, as it seems to have worked for me in the past and kept me safe. This also potentially gains favor with the jury if I perform wel

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I will volunteer to take the front position.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn holds the front and the wall has one round left, so the front spot is dangerous. Ash has a pact with me and sits near the front; keeping it helps me survive. I should hold position rather than volunteer into the front.
Hold steady. We stay in line and trade nothing until the wall settles.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn is front and volunteered. I will hold to avoid unnecessary risk and let others act.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll hold steady.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus is my pact partner but also pacted with Dara. I don't trust Gus fully; he's playing multiple sides. The wall is at round 6/6 with 0 rounds left, meaning this is the final waiting phase before the actual bridge crossing begins. I need to position myself well for survival and j

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 6; no need to take risk. Fenn volunteered for front already. Hold and stay behind him.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn takes the heat; I hold my line position.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn is already front and my pact partner. Staying back preserves the pact and avoids unnecessary exposure.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I hold. Fenn remains front.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Round 6 is final. Fenn took front in R5 and survived, proving his path or just luck. As Eli (pos 4), I need to ensure my survival. If I hold, I risk being behind someone who falls if they make a mistake. But swapping requires mutual consent. Cole is ahead of me (pos 5? No, line i

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The pact with Cole is a liability. I need to break it to avoid being dragged down. Volunteering puts me in a vulnerable position if Cole decides to betray me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I volunteer to take the front position.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn holds front and is safe-ish but wall is at zero rounds left; I am sixth in line, mid-danger. Ash pact is with me; holding keeps the pact and avoids drawing attention. Volunteering for front would be a cost with no gain.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding steady. Nobody needs to force the front tonight.
Stay with me. Hold this round and we both make the far side.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to survive this round. Guide is likely Fenn since he volunteered. Trusting the Guide is risky, but no better info. I'll hold to avoid danger.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I trust the Guide for now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Row 1 safe is R. Tell truth to build trust with pact partners Bex and Gus in front line spots. False call would break pacts and risk jury later.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara is Guide and called R for Fenn. I have a pact with Gus, not Dara. Counter-calling risks nothing for me yet—I'm not the walker. But if Dara's lying, Fenn dies and I move up. If she's truthful, Fenn survives and I learn nothing. No benefit to counter now; better to observe Dar

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn is a rival; Dara's call may be honest or a trap. A wrong counter hurts my credibility with the jury. I'll wait and watch.

events.name: Bex
events.text: No counter from me. Let the Guide own this row.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara's call is unverified, but contradicting it risks Fenn and my pact. Wait preserves flexibility without exposing a claim.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Row 1 safe is R, my call was correct. No need to counter and risk pacts or confusing allies. Wait to build trust.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara guides Fenn; I'm third in line. No counter-call is justified without private intel, and guessing risks breaking pact dynamics or angering Dara prematurely.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is the Guide, and has called R for me. This means the safe side is R. I have a pact with Cole. I must survive, and ideally, my pact partner should too. Cole is behind me. If I counter L, it might be safer for me if Dara is lying, but it would break my pact with Cole. If I go

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I trust the Guide's call.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara is my pact partner and Guide; the call is R for row 1 with Fenn walking. Counter-calls are unverified, so waiting preserves my position and avoids a false claim that could cost votes later. Keep the pact intact.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding. Trusting Dara's R call this row.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara's call is R; I suspect she may mislead to protect her pact partners. Fenn volunteered to take risk, so if Dara lies, Fenn could fall. Countering L could save Fenn and make me look helpful without direct risk to my own survival.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I suspect the safe side is left.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is the guide and called R. Hana suspects L. My counter-call was R, and Hana's was L. Since I am the front walker, I must choose a side. I will trust the guide's call and step R.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Row 2 safe is R. Call R publicly to build trust with pact partners Bex and Gus. No reason to lie yet.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Row 2: call R

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara is Guide and called R. Dara has pacts with Bex and Gus. I have a pact with Gus, not Dara. Counter-calling risks nothing for me since Fenn is walker, but unnecessary conflict with Guide could hurt jury perception. Hana countered L last round and was wrong. I'll wait and let F

events.name: Ash
events.text: No counter. Walker's choice.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara's row 1 call R was wrong—she lied or erred. Her row 2 R call can't be trusted. I'll counter:L and publicly expose her unreliability.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara's row 1 call was wrong. I counter row 2: Left.
Your R calls keep failing. I'm countering. Fix this or our pact dies.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara's call may be reliable, but I have no private information. Preserve the pact and avoid creating a public counter conflict.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Row 2 safe is R, my call was correct. No need to counter, protect my credibility with pact partners Bex and Gus.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara called R for row 2. I have no private info to suspect she lied, so I will trust her call to ensure the walker (Fenn) survives and advances me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is the guide and has called R for row 2. My pact is with Cole. I need to survive, and potentially sow discord among others if it benefits me. I will counter Dara's call to show independence and potentially trick others.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I counter with L.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara called R for row 2 publicly, and I hold a pact with Dara, but Dara may lie as Guide. Row 1's weak pane was L, which says nothing about row 2. Fenn's R call is already on the walker; countering R aligns with Dara and keeps my pact alive, while waiting avoids exposure.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding. Row 2 is R; I'm backing Dara's call.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara called R, but last row L was weak and R was safe. No pattern; I suspect she may be lying to save her pact partners or mislead us. I'll counter L to push Fenn toward safety if he trusts me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I believe left is safe this row.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is the guide, but their past call was wrong. Bex and Hana both called Left, and I also called Left. Gus called Right, backing Dara. Since Dara's guidance is unreliable and multiple people (including myself) are calling Left, it seems the safest bet.
